_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, client assets, expense, trading activity and pre-tax margin signals with Schwab's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'The Charles Schwab Corporation (CSC) ... engages, through its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as the Company), in wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, money management, custody, and financial advisory services.' 'Developments in the business, economic, and geopolitical environment could negatively impact the Company’s business.' 'The Company’s industry is characterized by aggressive price competition.' (FY2015 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets, rates and investor engagement and names price competition, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the JPM, LOW and SHW reading); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a securities broker and bank on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names brokerage or banking, and no 10-K names offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming or decarbonisation, and the FY2015 10-K names cloud computing only in an accounting standard ('In April 2015, the FASB issued ASU 2015-05, “Intangibles – Goodwill and Other – Internal-Use Software (Subtopic 350-40),” which provides new guidance that clarifies customer’s accounting for fees paid in a cloud computing arrangement.'), not as a way its own business is delivered or displaced), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -44.1%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +19.5%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.5%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +34.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SCHW (retrospective, 2016-12-23) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 11.29x (85.4% downside to Bear $5.89 / +7.6% upside to Bull $43.37) | Adj composite 2.40 vs market 3.30: gap -0.90 [OVERVALUED] | +106% above the EPP floor $19.57 (19x FY16E $1.03) | Conservative 2-yr case: -6.9% total (-3.5%/yr) | At 39.1x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $53.32 sits above the BULL case; revenue +19.8% YoY in Q3 2016, forward revenues +19.8% (Q3 2016 revenue growth (no Q4 2016 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
